name: Anna Cuomo
title: Anna Cuomo, PhD
eyebrow: Cellular genomics · Human genetics · Drug discovery
bio: I'm an Associate Principal Scientist at AstraZeneca's Centre for Genomic Research in London. A mathematician turned computational biologist, I work at the meeting point of **statistical methods** and **large-scale data**: I develop methods to map genetic effects on gene expression in single cells, such as CellRegMap and SAIGE-QTL, and apply them to population-scale cohorts such as TenK10K, the largest matched whole-genome and single-cell dataset to date. My goal is to understand how natural genetic variation and experimental perturbations shape cells, to reveal mechanism and help find new drug targets.
bioPrevious: Previously an EMBO postdoctoral fellow at the Garvan Institute in Sydney and a postdoc at the Wellcome Sanger Institute; PhD in Statistical Genetics from the University of Cambridge and EMBL-EBI.
description: Associate Principal Scientist at AstraZeneca's Centre for Genomic Research, London. Cellular genomics, human genetics and drug discovery.
